speedMps.title: Apollo EVA walking: O2 use and speed
speedMps.note: "Oxygen use was about 0.16 lb/hr per 1000 BTU/hr"; "1560 BTU/hr at 3.5 km/hr" -> ~113 g/h = 0.031 g/s (o2GPerS). Emergency return "3.6 km/hr for periods of up to an hour" -> 1.0 m/s (speedMps). Apollo, Moon; transferred to Mars (1/6 g -> 0.38 g). Overview: not used for planning.
speedMps.credit: E. M. Jones, Apollo Lunar Surface Journal

uphillFactor.title: Walk model coefficients
uphillFactor.note: uphill/downhill factors, max slope, hazard weight, reserve, energy: SPEC §7.3–7.4 values; no source (docs/SOURCES.md ## F5). Overview: not used for planning.

emergencyO2G.title: Emergency O2 reserve (EMU Secondary Oxygen Package)
emergencyO2G.note: NASA EVA overview (NTRS 20140009556): the EMU SOP "provides a minimum of 30 minutes of emergency O2". Grams = 1800 s x 0.031 g/s = 55.8 -> 56 g. ISS suit, not a Mars suit. Overview: not used for planning.

time.title: EVA time limit
time.note: 3600 s: 1 h EVA for the demo (SPEC §7.4). For reference: EMU EVA up to 7 h (NTRS 20140009556). Overview: not used for planning.

o2.title: O2 available for this EVA
o2.note: 140 g: 1 h of walking at the Apollo rate after the 20% reserve (0.031 g/s x 3600 s / 0.8 = 112 / 0.8); decision #20. Overview: not used for planning.

energy.title: Suit energy limit
energy.note: 600 Wh; not set in SPEC. Overview: not used for planning.

dose.title: Radiation dose limit
dose.note: No per-EVA dose limit -> null -> budget status incomplete (SPEC §7.6). Overview: not used for planning.

layers.name: Terrain (MOLA + HRSC)
layers.method: Trek bilinear to 600 m, mean of valid pixels per 2400 m cell

layers.name: Colour (Viking MDIM 2.1)
layers.method: exportImage resample to 2048² (~300 m/px); artistic colour

layers.name: Slope (derived)
layers.method: Horn 3x3 at 600 m, max per cell

sources.title: Mars MOLA + HRSC blended DEM 200 m
sources.note: Float32 TIFF via exportImage 1024² (600 m cells, bilinear by Trek) on the 614.4 km bbox; mean of valid pixels per 2400 m cell.
sources.credit: NASA/JPL/GSFC (MOLA), ESA/DLR/FU Berlin (HRSC), USGS Astrogeology, via NASA Mars Trek

sources.title: Viking MDIM 2.1 colorized global mosaic 232 m
sources.note: JPEG 2048² via exportImage (quality 80), same bbox; colours are artistic (USGS colorization), not true colour. Display only.
sources.credit: NASA/JPL (Viking), USGS Astrogeology (MDIM 2.1, colorized), via NASA Mars Trek

sources.title: Hazard derived from slope
sources.note: hazard = min(1, slopeDeg / 25) x 0.5; NoData = 1. Slope over 600 m, so cliffs look gentler than they are. Overview: not used for planning.

sources.title: Map centre
sources.note: Centre cell of the grid (lon -134.0, lat 18.4, IAU Gazetteer centre of Olympus Mons); no habitat. Overview: not used for planning.
